crossRefs.note: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.
Yahweh executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.
Yahweh preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.
Learn to do well. Seek justice. Relieve the oppressed. Defend the fatherless. Plead for the widow.”
Leave your fatherless children. I will preserve them alive. Let your widows trust in me.”
Assyria can’t save us. We won’t ride on horses; neither will we say any more to the work of our hands, ‘Our gods!’ for…
Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and…
Yet he didn’t leave himself without witness, in that he did good and gave you rains from the sky and fruitful seasons…

translations.web: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow and loves the foreigner in giving him food and clothing.
translations.bsb: He executes justice for the fatherless and widow, and He loves the foreigner, giving him food and clothing.
translations.kjv: He doth execute the judgment of the fatherless and widow, and loveth the stranger, in giving him food and raiment.
translations.asv: He doth execute justice for the fatherless and widow, and loveth the sojourner, in giving him food and raiment.
